3899-6854--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
3899-6854--5--195.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Host of the Hereafter trigger.
Resolve Host of the Hereafter's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature that has power 2 or greater

864-1987-7907.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
864-1987-7907.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
864-1987-7907.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

108-4499-7824.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Eyeless Watcher.
When Eyeless Watcher enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate three Eldrazi Scions by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1453-4559-6798-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
1453-4559-6798-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Arwen.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1170-1329-2478-4460.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard.
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1020-2604-2866-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {R}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Ugin, the Ineffable.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {R}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Ugin, the Ineffable.
Repeat.

3398-3975-7121.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Hellkite Charger
3398-3975-7121.description:
Activate Fire Nation Palace's second ability by paying {1}{R} and tapping it, giving Hellkite Charger firebending 4 until end of turn.
Declare Hellkite Charger as an attacker, triggering it and its firebending ability twice.
Resolve both Hellkite Charger firebending triggers, adding eight {R}.
Resolve the first Hellkite Charger trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the second Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

1322-4091-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Aphetto Alchemist.
Activate one of the Aphetto Alchemist tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Aphetto Alchemist token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

2366-4785-5234-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-4785-5234-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Heartbeat of Spring triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

147-1269-5686.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-1269-5686.description:
Cast Exhume by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Exhume.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Exhume
Resolve the Exhume copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

147-5260-6797.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-5260-6797.description:
Cast Entering by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Entering.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Entering, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Entering copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-5260-6797.notes: You can cast Breaking and Entering fused together to also get infinite mill and self-mill.

4693-5721-6664-6883.easyPrerequisites: There are at least six land cards between your graveyard and the battlefield under your control, one of which must be a Swamp, that can collectively tap to produce at least {3}{B}{B}{G}.
4693-5721-6664-6883.description:
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing any land, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat step 1 until you have at least six land cards in your graveyard, with one of those cards being a Swamp.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{B}{B}{G}.
Activate Strands of Night by paying {B}{B} and 2 life and sacrificing a Swamp, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aftermath Analyst enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Repeat.

1447-2719-6798.description:
Cast Angel of Glory's Rise by paying {5}{W}{W}.
When Angel of Glory's Rise enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Sakashima of a Thousand Faces
Resolve the Angel of Glory's Rise trigger, exiling all Zombies, and then returning all Humans from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Choose to have Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enter the battlefield as a copy of Angel of Glory's Rise.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

2457-2557-4289-6791.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

uses.n: Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist // Jetfire, Air Guardian

114-3263-4029.easyPrerequisites: Jetfire has no +1/+1 counters on it.
114-3263-4029.description:
Activate Jetfire, Air Guardian by paying {3}, converting it and putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, adding {4} and converting Jetfire.
Repeat.

3908-4659-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
Spark Double on the battlefield as a copy of Lonis.
3908-4659-5365.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Clue, adding {C}{C}.
Lonis and Spark Double's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Spark Double.
Spark Double's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Repeat.
3908-4659-5365.notes:
You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead sacrifice the Clues to their own abilities

215-6111.notablePrerequisites: Elves you control can tap to produce at least {4}{G}{G}.
215-6111.description:
Activate any number of Elves you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{G}{G}.
Each Elf tapped this way triggers, untapping it and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Dionus from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Dionus by paying {3}{G}, which enters the battlefield as a new object, thus granting a fresh instance of the ability to each Elf you control.
Repeat.

1437-6016.notablePrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
1437-6016.description:
Cast Proud Pack-Rhino by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Myojin by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Proud Pack-Rhino spell three times.
Resolve the first Proud Pack-Rhino spell.
When the Proud Pack-Rhino token enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin.
Repeat from step 2.
1437-6016.notes: This combo results in infinite copies of the Proud Pack-Rhino spell on the stack, which you can then resolve to infinitely proliferate. This can put infinite indestructible counters on Myojin to infinitely copy any permanent spell(s) you cast in the future.

71-307-3542.notablePrerequisites:
Mukotai Ambusher and Palinchron do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block Mukotai Ambusher or Palinchron.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}{B}.
71-307-3542.description:
Declare Palinchron and Mukotai Ambusher as attackers.
When they aren't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{U}{B}.
Activate Thousand-Faced Shadow's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{U} and returning Mukotai Ambusher from the battlefield to your hand, putting Thousand-Faced Shadow onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Thousand-Faced Shadow enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a token copy of Palinchron that is tapped and attacking.
When the Palinchron token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Mukotai Ambusher's ninjutsu ability by paying {1}{B} and returning Thousand-Faced Shadow from the battlefield to your hand, putting Mukotai Ambusher onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
Deal combat damage using the Palinchron tokens, dealing infinite combat damage to the defending opponent.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

2117-4050-4230.description:
Cast Spiteful Hexmage by paying {B}.
When Spiteful Hexmage enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Cursed Role token attached to it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Spiteful Hexmage, adding {B}.
Spiteful Hexmage is returned to your hand instead of being put into your graveyard due to Necromancer's Magemark.
Repeat.

413-1069-1475.notablePrerequisites:
One with the Kami attached to any creature you control.
You control at least one Equipment.
You control at least one additional creature.
413-1069-1475.description:
Activate an Equipment's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to any creature you control except Puresteel Paladin or the creature that has One with the Kami attached.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with the Equipment attached.
When the creature dies, One with the Kami triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to that creature's power.
When the Spirit(s) enter the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers that many times, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 2, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

380-643-2232-2743.description:
Cast Biovisionary by paying {1}{G}{U}.
When Biovisionary enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio and Miirym trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Miirym trigger, creating a token copy of Biovisionary.
When the Biovisionary token enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning the nontoken Biovisionary to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat from step 1 one additional time.
Repeat steps 1 though 4 one additional time.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger from the Biovisionary token, choosing not to return anything to your hand from the battlefield.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

24-1167-4761.description:
Activate Teferi's +1 loyalty ability, allowing you to cast sorcery spells whenever you could cast an instant until your next turn.
Activate Mindslaver by paying {4}, tapping it, and sacrificing it, gaining control of them during their next turn.
Move to their turn.
Cast Wheel of Misfortune by paying {2}{R}, selecting an arbitrarily large number for the opponent you control, and dealing that much damage to the opponent  if the oponent chose the largest number.
If the opponent didn't choose the largest number, Wheel of Misfortune deals that much damage to each opponent who chose the largest number.

803-2034-3413.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Arcane Adaptation, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat.
